prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving–shipping release; pallets remain inside. Goals: timely/accurate dispatch, safety/inventory compliance; no explicit modes. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass): authoritative inventory/location/eligibility/expectations/priorities/tasks/constraints; reconciles work, authorizes moves/reservations, prevents duplicates; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment (destination/priority/load-sequence); consumes load advisory, enforces handling constraints, blocks incompatible allocations. Requests require unique task-reference/destination/safety-constraints. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook): validates vehicle/carrier/trailer/window; directs drivers with door/lane/crew/clearance, otherwise holds/reassigns; records discrepancies, blocks risks, consumes Trailer Seal Exception Note. Yard personnel notify receiving staff of departure-readiness. Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay): verifies identity/seals/documents/counts/expectations before handling; separates damage, sends exception note; consumes inspection-stage advisory, records proceed/rework/hold. Holds stay segregated until validated review; Inbound Pallet Buffer staging implies no inventory acceptance. Closure/allocation needs count/inspection/door-release records. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry) produces Oversize Load Advisory, not authorization. Allocation requires dimensions/mass/compatibility/retrievability/clearance/restricted-position approval; mismatches block automation; holds retain scan/location/detection-time/reason. Identify before conveyor. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven) produces validated Transfer Induction Ticket; holds duplicates/blockages/uncertain exceptions; requires presence/interlocks/downstream-readiness/single-admission merges; recovery verifies readiness/order. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor: separate routes. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur): valid vehicle/area/route/destination, priority/battery/proximity selection; access/pedestrian/restriction/readiness/speed/turn controls; pickup/identity confirmation, stop/reroute; produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation (vehicle/pallet/time/receiving-position/incomplete/deferred moves). North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane: separated aisles, controlled crossings, valid targets/access/task-state; North consumes reservation receipt, sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot; stale reports hold induction. North reports positioning/retention/braking/travel faults; unavailable pending inspection/adjacent-equipment safety. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield) records outcome/authorizer, produces Crane Service Release Card;

New part:
S172: A recovery response begins when a position discrepancy, obstruction, or safety alarm makes continued automatic movement uncertain.
S173: Fire Alarm Panel and Safety Zone Controller retain authority to stop or restrict movement whenever their safety status requires it.
S174: Safety Zone Controller establishes a controlled boundary around the affected aisle and prevents new equipment from entering it.
S175: Warehouse Operations Supervisor verifies that personnel are clear of the boundary before authorizing recovery work.
S176: Conveyor Line Controller holds transfers that could feed material into the isolated area.
S177: Morrowglass, the Warehouse Management System, receives the occupancy snapshot for recovery planning.
S178: Warehouse Management System reconciles its location records with available sensor data before it presents a recovery plan.
S179: Velvetrook applies the yard exception by holding affected vehicle movements outside the recovery boundary.
S180: Yard traffic remains under controlled access until the aisle is confirmed safe for normal operations.
S181: The recovery plan identifies the permitted travel envelope, the expected stopping point, and the conditions that require an immediate stop.
S182: South Aisle Stacker Crane performs a controlled recovery maneuver at reduced speed within the isolated aisle.
S183: The maneuver uses only the travel needed to reach a stable position or clear the obstruction under review.
S184: Personnel remain outside the crane travel envelope throughout the maneuver.
S185: A spotter may observe from a protected location but does not enter the isolated aisle while motion is enabled.
S186: Any unexpected movement, loss of position confidence, or renewed alarm causes an immediate stop and reassessment.
S187: Safety Zone Controller maintains the boundary until the cause of the stop has been understood and the recovery plan has been checked again.
S188: Inbound Pallet Buffer remains unavailable to new receipts when its access path intersects the isolated area.
S189: East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor remain stopped where their movement could compromise the boundary.
S190: Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives a hold instruction for routes that approach the recovery area.
S191: Maintenance Release Terminal records the inspection outcome and any repair work required before equipment can return to service.
S192: Warehouse Operations Supervisor reconciles outstanding exceptions, maintenance holds, and access constraints before releasing normal work.
S193: A controlled test confirms that the equipment responds correctly to stop commands and that its reported position is stable.
S194: The isolation boundary is removed only after the test passes and the aisle is clear of personnel and loose material.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
